# Lisa Eldridge Beauty

> > Lisa Eldridge Beauty offers luxury makeup and skincare-infused cosmetics, including The Foundation, True Velvet Lipsticks, Rouge Experience refillables, and award-winning Seamless Skin Tints.

Founded by renowned makeup artist Lisa Eldridge, this beauty brand emphasizes clean formulations, sustainable packaging, and artisan craftsmanship. The site features product collections, celebrity makeup tutorials (Social Looks), and innovative techniques like the Patchwork Skin method.
